newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yue Yuen expands in HK$248 mln acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Yue Yuen expands in HK$248 mln acquisition.

text.p: Athletic shoemaker Yue Yuen Industrial (Holdings) Ltd said in a statement on Wednesday shareholders approved a deal to acquire the entire operations and assets of Pou Yuen Industrial (Holdings) Ltd.

Yue Yuen said in a statement it was paying a total of HK$248.48 million and will issue 647.05 million shares as consideration for the 55 percent of Pou Yuen it does not already own. Asia Ltd has been appointed advisor of the acquisition, it said in a statement.
Yue Yuen currently owns a 45 percent stake in Pou Yuen and the acquisition plan was approved in a special general meeting of shareholders on Wednesday, the statement said.

The purchase would more than double Yue Yuen's production capacity with more than 120 production lines operating in China, Vietnam and Indonesia, and further consolidate its status as a leading athletic shoe manufacturer, it said.
Yue Yuen manufactures shoes for brands such as Nike, Reebok, Adidas, Timberland and Rockport.
